title: Deadline recovery never re-enqueues in the cloud: _job_for_turn reads an in-memory job list
description: Found while tracing chatticus-a20667. control_plane.py:3779 _job_for_turn reads self._jobs, empty in the deadline Lambda (plane_from_env), so handle_turn_deadline's recovery re-enqueue is a no-op; and infra/lib/thin-turn-stack.ts:85 TurnJobs has no dead-letter queue or maxReceiveCount, so a failing job is retried every visibility timeout (~180s) for the 4-day retention, calling the model provider each time.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Triage 2026-10-14: closing as obsolete (Python-era). control_plane.py and _job_for_turn were deleted with the Python tree (PR 467); no job_for_turn exists in conversation/src. Deadline recovery is now the probe mechanism (conversation/src/turn, features/turn_probes.feature: a probe armed at claim recovers an expired lease and enqueues a new run). The missing dead-letter queue is fixed too: infra/lib/control-plane-stack.ts creates a dead-letter queue per queue with maxReceiveCount = DEAD_LETTER_MAX_RECEIVE_COUNT (lines ~113-122), so a failing job no longer retries for the 4-day retention.

right_now_summary: The obsolete Python issue was removed, and deadline recovery and dead-letter handling now work in the new system.
